introHtml: Renewable lunch bags, boxes, and totes are made from materials like rPET or sustainably sourced fabrics, reducing reliance on virgin plastics. For safety managers and HR directors looking to align corporate gifts with environmental goals, these items offer practical branding with a lighter footprint. The Renew rPET Lunch Cooler, for instance, combines recycled content with reliable insulation. Decorate with your logo using screen printing or embroidery for a professional finish that stands out in break rooms or at trade shows.
